title: An App Built for One: Why a Devpost Skill Pack Made Me Spec It Anyway
why_read: A personal story about building a small custom business app for a family bakery using an AI-assisted spec tool, light on technical depth but a relatable small-scale project.
analysis: This post describes a personal project where the author built a simple inventory and invoicing app for his wife's bakery business, using a hackathon's AI-powered 'skill pack' that interviews the user and generates a project specification. The interesting technical nugget is that the AI-generated plan caught some real design issues early but also carried forward one incorrect assumption that only testing revealed. It's a nice illustration of both the benefits and limits of AI-assisted spec writing, but overall it's a lightweight anecdotal piece rather than deep technical content. Useful mainly for readers curious about practical, low-stakes applications of AI planning tools.
